description: Astera Bond helps users organize relationship context across separate Connections and saved interaction episodes. It compares a specific episode with the relationship goal the user selected, separates observable facts from unknowns, lets users save past events on their real dates, and summarizes how saved episodes change over time. Episode Signals apply only to a specific episode relative to the user's goal; Astera Bond does not score, diagnose, or assign personality labels to people. Users can start without signing in and optionally protect and sync their saved history with an Astera Bond account.

defaultPrompt: Analyze this interaction relative to my relationship goal and separate observable facts from unknowns.
Show me how this Connection has changed over time based on my saved episodes.
Show my recent Bond episodes and explain what direction they suggest relative to my goal.
